outputs.discrepancies: Within panel B, the quantification plot labels the second mutant strain as 'cmtR-pacL2^{G17L+G20L}-ctpG', while the corresponding disk-diffusion photograph on the right is labeled 'pacL2^{G17A+G20A}'. These are different amino-acid substitutions (Leu vs Ala) and this mutant is consistently referred to as G17L+G20L elsewhere in the figure (panels C, D, E, F, G, H, I), so the photo label appears to be an error, creating an inconsistency between the two halves of the same panel.

Caption states panel H shows 'cluster sizes', but the image labeled H displays a plot titled 'Mol.% into clusters' (percentage of molecules localized into clusters), which matches the description given for panel I instead.

Caption states panel I shows 'the proportion of molecules localized within a cluster per cell', but the image labeled I displays a plot titled 'Clusters size (nm^3)' on a log scale, which matches the description given for panel H instead. Panels H and I appear swapped relative to the caption.
